points.point: Eurosystem increased LTRO refinancing significantly while cutting MRO refinancing correspondingly
patterns: (?:MROs?|one-week main refinancing|main refinancing operations)(?:(?!LTRO|longer-term refinancing).){0,80}(?:reduc|cut|trim|lower|decreas)|(?:reduc|cut|trim|lower|decreas)(?:(?!LTRO|longer-term refinancing).){0,80}(?:MROs?|one-week main refinancing|main refinancing operations)
points.quote: The amount of refinancing provided via longer-term refinancing operations (LTROs) has been increased significantly with a view to smooth conditions in the term money market. The amount of refinancing provided via the one-week main refinancing operations (MROs) was reduced correspondingly, so that the total amount of outstanding refinancing has remained unchanged.
paraphrases: ECB shifted liquidity toward longer-term operations, boosting LTRO allotments while cutting one-week MRO allotments by a corresponding amount
